mapper.select: SELECT id FROM starlit_pack WHERE pack_key = #{packKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_starlit_progress (user_id, pack_id, stars_lit, last_question_no) VALUES (#{userId}, #{packId}, #{starsLit}, #{lastQuestionNo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stars_lit = #{starsLit}, last_question_no = #{lastQuestionNo}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT question_no AS questionNo, stem AS stem, option_a AS optionA, option_b AS optionB, option_c AS optionC, option_d AS optionD, correct_answer AS correctAnswer FROM starlit_question WHERE pack_id = #{packId} AND is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY question_no ASC
SELECT k.pack_key AS packKey, p.stars_lit AS starsLit, p.last_question_no AS lastQuestionNo FROM user_starlit_progress p INNER JOIN starlit_pack k ON k.id = p.pack_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}
